min_per_cert_today.label: Minutes per certificate today
min_per_cert_today.basis: estimate: Read a certificate, compare its limits and file the result by hand.

min_per_cert_tool.label: Minutes per certificate with the tool
min_per_cert_tool.basis: estimate: Check the extracted values and complete one approval or decision.

certs_per_year.label: Certificates per year
certs_per_year.basis: sourced: design notes and c4 volume cases; 35 per project, renewals and scale ceiling.

monthly_check_min_today.label: Monthly check minutes per project today
monthly_check_min_today.basis: estimate: Search the records for lapses, renewals and missing tax forms before payment.

monthly_check_min_tool.label: Monthly check minutes per project with the tool
monthly_check_min_tool.basis: estimate: Review the payment hold list and resolve the named reasons.

projects.label: Projects
projects.basis: sourced: design notes; four concurrent fictional projects.

hourly_rate_usd.label: Staff cost per hour
hourly_rate_usd.basis: estimate: Illustrative fully loaded staff cost; replace with the firm's own rate.

lapses_paid_per_year.label: Payments with a lapse per year today
lapses_paid_per_year.basis: estimate: Zero in the floor case; one likely lapse and two in the high case.

cost_per_incident_usd.label: Cost per lapse
cost_per_incident_usd.basis: estimate: Time and cost to resolve a payment made during a coverage lapse; excludes insured losses.

catch_rate.label: Share of lapses caught
catch_rate.basis: estimate: A dated payment hold list catches half to nine tenths of lapses; people still act on it.

hours_per_audit_today.label: Hours per audit today
hours_per_audit_today.basis: estimate: Gather certificates, email decisions and payment records from separate folders.

hours_per_audit_tool.label: Hours per audit with the tool
hours_per_audit_tool.basis: estimate: Check the certificate archive and the recorded decisions.

audits_per_year.label: Audits per year
audits_per_year.basis: estimate: One to three requests for a project insurance record each year.

api_cost_per_year_usd.label: Certificate reading spend per year
api_cost_per_year_usd.basis: sourced: docs/research/c4-gemini-api-cost.md; cost assumptions from the build research.

upkeep_hours_per_month.label: Upkeep hours per month
upkeep_hours_per_month.basis: estimate: Check failed uploads, timers and model changes; includes routine owner support.
